meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析、比较和可视化系统发育树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理系统发育树或需要比较物种进化关系
copy.tagline_en: Analyze, compare, and visualize phylogenetic trees
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with phylogenetic trees and need to compare or annotate them

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 可以加载、编辑、分析、比较和可视化系统发育树（Newick/NHX 格式），检测复制/物种形成事件，整合 NCBI 分类信息，并生成 PDF/SVG 出版级图表。
howto.when: 当你提供树文件（如 Newick 格式）或要求分析、操作、可视化树时触发。

say.text: 帮我加载 tree.nw 并显示基本统计信息。
say.note: Claude 会输出树的叶子数、节点数等。

say.text: 对这个基因树进行复制与物种形成事件检测。
say.note: Claude 会标记复制和物种形成节点。

say.text: 比较两个树文件的拓扑差异。
say.note: Claude 会计算 Robinson-Foulds 距离。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can load, manipulate, analyze, compare, and visualize phylogenetic trees (Newick/NHX), detect duplication/speciation events, integrate NCBI taxonomy, and generate publication-quality figures in PDF/SVG.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you provide a tree file (e.g., Newick format) or ask to analyze, manipulate, or visualize a tree.

say_en.text: Load tree.nw and show basic statistics.
say_en.note: Claude will output leaf count, node count, etc.

say_en.text: Detect duplication and speciation events in this gene tree.
say_en.note: Claude will mark duplication and speciation nodes.

say_en.text: Compare topological differences between two tree files.
